instrumentation.changes: Record native timer clocks and ball state before each physics update while RefTraceOn is true. Optional exact-clock input at RefDriveAt is delivered at the start of LeftFlipper_Timer. Authored timer bodies and rules are retained.

ballTrails.positionPhase: Timer observes the preceding physics step; the final completed-step position is captured before each controlled reset.

instrumentation.nativeRngMarkers: RNG_FRAME emitted before each physics step; the browser probe reads the unmodified engine state synchronously when this debug message is written.

nativeRandom.capture: Read-only WASM memory reads synchronized to native Debug.Print frame markers.
nativeRandom.replay: Seed once from the observed first physics frame, then audit every subsequent observed state without reseeding.

timerSynchronization: RollingTimer disabled/enabled immediately before each initial state, resetting its 10ms phase.
comparisonScope: playable ball including authored spin and speed controls
regressionLimitProvenance: Sample limits unchanged from the original camera test. Additional every-millisecond checks include observed full body states, native position histories and read-only native RNG frame states.
